outline: To improve the fundamental knowledge of water chemistry, including thermodynamics, Chemistry Kinetics, Acid-base chemistry and redox reaction.
schedule:
Week	Contents
1 	Introduction (Chap 1)
2 	Equilibrium-Thermodynamics (Chap 3)
3 	Chemistry Kinetics (Chap 5)
4 	Kinetics for Chemical reactors (Chap 5)
5 	Solving Ionic Equilibria Problems (Chap 7)
6 	First midterm
7 	Acid-base chemistry (Chap 8)
8 	Alkalinity and Carbonate system (Chap 8)
9 	EPA model: Mineql+ (Chap 7, Chap 8)
10 	EPA model: Mineql+ (Chap 7, Chap 8)
11 	Second midterm
12 	Redox reaction (Chap 11)
13 	Redox reaction-pE-pC diagram (Chap 11)
14 	Redox reaction- corrosion (Chap 11)
15 	Final examination
assessment:
Mid term twice	40 %
Preclass reading and Homework	20 %
Report and presentation	15 %
Final examination (could be oral)	25 %
